_comment: Terminal AUTO-mode module for a permanently-paired Plantower PMS5003. UART1/GPIO0/1 carry the sensor signal (GPIO0=ESP TX->PMS RX, GPIO1=ESP RX<-PMS TX) instead of the downstream POGO face, so downstream_port is deliberately and completely disabled. This module can only be a terminal LEAF.
_downstream_comment: Terminal-only invariant: every downstream hardware field is -1. GPIO0/1 and UART1 belong exclusively to PMS5003 on this board.
